title: How Interest Accrues on Your Cobalt Blue Balance
summary: Explains that the Cobalt Blue balance earns 0.5% APY with daily compounding, meaning interest accrues on available/deposited funds immediately and is calculated on the current balance plus prior accrued interest. Shows how to track accrued interest on the account dashboard and confirm the 0.5% APY on eligible balances.
